motions.item_title: Municipal Accommodation Tax Update and Administration Policy - 2024-132
motions.text: That the Municipal Accommodation Tax Administration Policy, included as Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024, be approved. That the annual Destination Animation Program, as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024, to commence second quarter (Q2) 2024, be approved. That the annual Gather Here Sponsorship Program as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132 dated April 3, 2024, to commence in Q2 2024, be approved. That the Destination Gaps and Needs funding Program as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024, to commence in Q2 2024, be approved. That the authority to award funding programs through the Municipal Accommodation Tax Administration Policy be delegated to the Deputy Chief Administration Officer of Public Services, as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Municipal Accommodation Tax Administration Policy, included as Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024, be approved.
  2. That the annual Destination Animation Program, as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024, to commence second quarter (Q2) 2024, be approved.
  3. That the annual Gather Here Sponsorship Program as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132 dated April 3, 2024, to commence in Q2 2024, be approved.
  4. That the Destination Gaps and Needs funding Program as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024, to commence in Q2 2024, be approved.
  5. That the authority to award funding programs through the Municipal Accommodation Tax Administration Policy be delegated to the Deputy Chief Administration Officer of Public Services, as outlined in Attachment-1 to Report 2024-132, dated April 3, 2024.

motions.item_title: Code of Conduct Investigation Report - Complaints 2023-02, 2023-03, 2024-1
motions.text: That the City Clerk be directed, in collaboration with the Integrity Commissioner, to review the Code of Conduct for Council and Local Boards and the Use of Corporate Resources During an Election Policy as they relate to the use of personal versus corporate social media accounts and administered groups and report back as a part of the 2025 Governance Review. That the General Manager of Strategic Communications and Community Engagement be directed to offer social media training, including accessibility standards and guidelines, to members of City Council.
motions.text_html:
1. That the City Clerk be directed, in collaboration with the Integrity Commissioner, to review the Code of Conduct for Council and Local Boards and the Use of Corporate Resources During an Election Policy as they relate to the use of personal versus corporate social media accounts and administered groups and report back as a part of the 2025 Governance Review. 
  2. That the General Manager of Strategic Communications and Community Engagement be directed to offer social media training, including accessibility standards and guidelines, to members of City Council.
